title: Actuator endpoint exposure not configured explicitly
description: The project includes spring-boot-starter-actuator, but application.properties does not set management.endpoints.web.exposure.include to a specific, minimal list. The standard requires explicit actuator exposure rather than relying on framework defaults.
standard: Backend 3: Actuator endpoint exposure must be explicit

title: User input reflected unsanitized in API response
description: The POST /data handler concatenates the raw request body into the HTTP response string without encoding or validation. A client that renders this response as HTML could be vulnerable to reflected XSS.

title: Request body logged to stdout
description: The POST /data handler writes the full request body to System.out.println, which can expose sensitive submitted data in application logs.

title: AppComponent is not standalone
description: AppComponent is declared with standalone: false and is registered in AppModule declarations instead of using standalone: true.

title: Contact form data logged to browser console
description: onSubmit logs the entire form value object to console.log. The User model includes email and password fields, so submitted PII can leak to the browser console.
